title: fix minor spelling errors
body:
**Summary**
This PR fixes a couple of comma errors in the `/documentation/` and `/about/` docs pages.
There are no linked issues to my knowledge.

**Note**
For some reason, the GitHub highlighter does not show the exact changes on `line 8` in the `docs/about.md`. To speed-up the check, here is what was changed on line 8:

```
For example [secured API Keys]
->
For example, [secured API Keys]`
```

```
the UI itself is complex and time consuming because
->
the UI itself is complex and time-consuming because
```
